{{Hatnote|This page is printed Decipher cards plus original Virtual Set 1 (2002 PDF slips). It is not current [[Virtual Set 1]] and not [[Premiere to Virtual Set 3]].}}
'''Premiere - Original VS1''' ('''POVS1''') is the constructed pool of printed Decipher cards through [[Theed Palace]] plus original [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy|Virtual Set 1]].<ref name="vc1">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050813215254/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/virtual/VirtualCards1.pdf VirtualCards1.pdf], decipher.com (Wayback, 13 August 2005). Current copy: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1a.pdf VirtualCards1a.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks.</ref> Virtual Set 1 became tournament-legal on 9 March 2002.<ref name="vs2002">[[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]</ref>
